description: Defines data structures and utility functions related to usage cost summaries, including totals per day, individual day details, and summary aggregation. Also includes a loader actor for asynchronous data fetching.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageTotals
classes.description: Stores total usage cost metrics such as input, output, cache reads/writes, total tokens, total cost, and missing entries.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageDay
classes.description: Represents usage data for a specific day, encapsulating a date string and associated totals.

classes.name: GatewayCostUsageSummary
classes.description: Contains the overall usage summary including update timestamp, number of days, daily breakdown, and aggregate totals.

classes.name: CostUsageFormatting
classes.description: Provides static methods for formatting cost and token count values into user-friendly strings.

classes.name: CostUsageLoader
classes.description: An actor providing an asynchronous method to load the usage cost summary data from a shared control channel.

methods.name: formatUsd
methods.description: Formats a Double value into a USD string with appropriate decimal places based on magnitude.

methods.name: formatTokenCount
methods.description: Formats an integer token count into a human-readable string, using 'k' or 'm' suffixes.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and decodes the usage cost summary data.
